name: reflect
description: Spots a lasting rule in a prompt you type and, after Claude's reply, asks where to save it: auto memory or a CLAUDE.md file.

toAutoMemory.title: Offer auto memory
toAutoMemory.description: Offer to save a rule in the project's auto-memory folder.

toProjectClaudeMd.title: Offer the project CLAUDE.md
toProjectClaudeMd.description: Offer to save a rule in the CLAUDE.md of the working directory.

toGlobalClaudeMd.title: Offer the global CLAUDE.md
toGlobalClaudeMd.description: Offer to save a rule in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, which applies to every project.

secondBrainPath.title: Second Brain folder
secondBrainPath.description: Folder of your Second Brain. Empty means the destination is off. Not built yet.

cues.title: Cue words
cues.description: Comma-separated words and phrases. Only a prompt that holds one is checked for a rule.
